Repeated eight-class synthetic metadata sessions with SQLite alert commits. Core event processing + persistence; excludes capture, HTTP, SSE and rendering. This saved result does not measure browser delivery or real deployment capacity.

Model scores and heuristic strengths are not calibrated probabilities of compromise. Public-source validation remains limited, including incomplete DGA coverage and unvalidated encrypted-malware detection. Evidence and analyst review are essential.
